messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Smart-routing alert: Elevated error rate + incorrect model outputs for eu-west-1. Observed: clients receiving responses from wrong model variant and occasional malformed KV contraints. Paging oncall: @mia (oncall).

mia (oncall): acked. looking now.

mia (oncall): quick glance at routing dashboard — a bunch of eu-west requests are being routed to 'global:variant-v2-small' then bouncing to 'fallback:variant-c' repeatedly. latency + error loops show up ~ 07:12UTC.

alex (eng-sre): seeing a sharp drop in regional KV hit rate for eu-west; global hit rate stable. Logs show keys being looked up with prefix that lacks region suffix. e.g. requests from eu-west hitting keys like `kv:modelX:v2` instead of `kv:eu-west-1:modelX:v2`.

sanjay (eng-runtime): possible cause: recent runtime rollout (2026-03-10) changed cache key normalization to `model:variant` (intended for cross-region dedupe) but we missed including region tag behind flag. That makes eu requests reuse global KV entries which are incompatible (different kv shapes) -> invalid states returned -> triggers fallback policy -> routing loop.

taylor (product): any customer impact numbers? which tenants affected?

lee (cs): CS: two paying customers reported degraded outputs: acme-eu and velocorp-eu. Both saw elevated hallucinations and retries. Severity: P1 for CS. I'm on the call with Acme.

mia (oncall): immediate mitigation proposal: 1) disable global KV cache for eu-west via routing policy (force bypass), 2) start targeted eviction of contaminated keys for eu region, 3) roll a runtime hotfix to restore region tag in cache key. I'll start 1 now.

alex (eng-sre): I'll apply bypass. running internal API:

```bash
curl -X PATCH https://internal-routing.redwood/api/v1/policies/smart-routing \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region_overrides": {"eu-west-1": {"kv_cache_enabled": false}}}'
```

alex (eng-sre): applied. confirming metrics — KV hits for eu-west dropped to ~0 and backend fetches increased (expected). routing now forces fresh model loads.

sanjay (eng-runtime): drafting hotfix to restore region tag. quick patch (pseudo):

```diff
- key = f"kv:{model_name}:{variant}"
+ key = f"kv:{region}:{model_name}:{variant}"
```

sanjay (eng-runtime): pushing hotfix to canary nodes in eu-west now (deploy id: deploy/2026-03-15-hotfix-1123).

incident-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-1897 and notified oncall handoff.

mia (oncall): next step: evict stale cross-region entries from caches to prevent any leftover misuse. we should do targeted eviction to avoid redis CPU spike. Proposed command (targeted scan + unlink):

```bash
redis-cli -h redis-eu-01 --scan --pattern 'kv:*:*' | sed -n '1,100p' | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli -h redis-eu-01 UNLINK
```

alex (eng-sre): caution — mass delete can spike CPU/IO. i'll run a rolling script that UNLINKs small batches and monitors CPU. using `--pattern 'kv:eu-west-1:*'` to ensure we only touch eu keys.

lee (cs): CS will send an interim notification to Acme/Velocorp: "We observed region-specific inference inconsistencies; mitigation in progress; no data exfiltration; updates in 30m."

sanjay (eng-runtime): hotfix applied to canary and then to eu-west fleet. quick sanity tests: end-to-end kv lookups now include region tag and we see previously mismatched keys not returned.

mia (oncall): can we confirm that wrong-variant routing has stopped?

alex (eng-sre): routing logs: fallbacks/trips for eu-west down from 18/min to 0-1/min in the last 5m. latency normalized.

sanjay (eng-runtime): metrics show recovered kv hit rate (region-scoped) and no additional malformed responses. rolling promotion to remaining nodes now.

incident-bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED. Impact: 2 customers affected, degraded output quality and retries; no data loss; root cause suspected = cache key normalization removed region tag during recent runtime change.

mia (oncall): handing off monitoring to alex for the night. Alex, please watch for re-appearance of cross-region cache hits and any spike in retries. Create follow-up issues: - postmortem doc - add canary checks for cache key formats - add automated test to ensure region included in key - SLA/credits review with CS/Product.

alex (eng-sre): ack. I'll open follow-ups and set alerts: if fallback rate > 2/min in eu-west or kv-miss rate deviates > 5% from baseline, page oncall.

taylor (product): product will coordinate postmortem + customer comms. we'll triage SLA impact and credit requests.

lee (cs): I'll close customer notifications once stable for 45m and provide timeline + mitigation summary.

mia (oncall): wrapping up: root cause -> key normalization change omitted region tag; fix -> hotfix + targeted eviction + routing bypass; follow-ups -> postmortem + tests + canary. Thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1897 ticket updated: severity lowered to SEV-MITIGATED. Please add logs/links to the postmortem when available. :white_check_mark:
